comments.body:
Most courses couldn't care less whether you show up to the lectures, generally the only thing that matters is that you show up to the exam and pass it.

There's some courses that have mandatory attendance (usually things like labs and the like that lack a traditional exam)

Notably there's the deadline to sign up for courses, which is usually two weeks after the semester starts. So make sure you're signed up for all the courses that you want to take before then.
comments.author: Tomathor13
